title: Create the key only if nobody else has
note: There is no `version` field to compare against on a key that was never written, so the comparison is made against zeros. That is what makes `VERSION EQUAL 0` mean "absent", and what makes this one request a lock.

title: The same request, once the key is there
note: The loser learns who won without a second round trip, because the failure branch read the key. Nothing was written: the header's revision is the same one the put before it reported.
